title: Parameters A, B, C, D and Graph of y = 2*sin(x + pi) - 1
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For the general sine function f(x) = A\sin\left(\frac{2\pi}{B}(x - C)\right) + D, identify the constants A, B, C, and D for y = 2\sin(x + \pi) - 1 and describe its graph.

steps.title: Rewrite the Equation in Standard Sinusoid Form
steps.explanation: Write the coefficient 1 of (x + pi) as 2*pi/(2*pi) and rewrite x + pi as x - (-pi).
steps.why: Matching the template A*sin((2*pi/B)*(x - C)) + D exposes each parameter directly.

steps.title: Read Off the Four Parameters A, B, C, and D
steps.explanation: Comparison gives amplitude |A| = 2 (with A = 2), period B = 2*pi, horizontal shift C = -pi (pi units left), and vertical shift D = -1 (1 unit down).
steps.why: Each constant corresponds to one geometric transformation of the base sine wave.

steps.title: Describe the Graph and Key Landmarks
steps.explanation: The wave oscillates between y = -3 and y = 1 around the horizontal line y = -1, completing one full period of length 2*pi from x = -pi to x = pi.
steps.why: D +/- |A| = -1 +/- 2 gives the minimum -3 and maximum 1.
